text_block_list.text:
An October day at the racetrack. The 
crowd, including Taiki Shuttle, cheered 
wildly as the overwhelmingly popular 
Umamusume dashed past.

"The Otherworldly Escapist"... Silence 
Suzuka. In this race as well, she claims 
victory with a daring front-running lead!

Having delivered an "unforgettable" run, 
Silence Suzuka was praised by the crowd 
for her victory in the Winner's Circle.
